| `content`    | `{fields?: Array<object>, source?: object, link?: object, hideEmpty?: boolean, emptyText?: string}` |          | `\{\}`  | The widget configuration. - `fields` — the entries, in order. Each is `{ path, label?, as?, from?, format?, map?, itemPath?, parts?, separator?, route?, variant?, variantMap?, colorMap?, icon?, copy?, reveal?, text?, title?, subtitle?, initialsPath?, tone? }`. `as` is `row` (default when `label` or `icon` is set), `title`, `line`, `text` (a line in the normal ink), `lead` (an icon tile or initials beside `title` and `subtitle`), `pill` or `meter`. A `meter` shows the amount at `path` against the limit at `limitPath` (or a constant `limit`) as "12 of 50" with a bar; past the limit the bar turns red and the text says "over the limit"; without a positive limit it shows the amount and no bar. A row's `format` may also be `email`, `phone` or `url` (a link) or `masked` (the last four characters; `reveal: true` adds Show). `copy: true` adds a copy button; `icon` replaces the label. A part may be `{ text }`, a constant; a `line` or `text` entry without `path` or `parts` shows its `text`. `resolve: { register, schema, labelField? }` on an entry or a part turns a value that is a reference (an id, or a list of ids) into the label of the referenced object (`labelField`, else `title`, then `name`): the case type or status of a task shows its name, not its uuid. The ids are fetched once per register and schema through the object store and shared by every facts widget on the page; the entry stays empty until its label is known, and when no label can be read. A resolved value works as a pill too: `map` is applied to the resolved label, and `variantMap` / `colorMap` look the tone up by the value of `resolve.toneField` on the referenced object when that is set (a status named by its `name`, coloured by its `state`), then by the resolved label, then by the stored value. `route` (`{ name, params?, query? }`, `@source.&lt;path&gt;` in a param) on a `title` or a `row` links its value to that route; a param that does not fill leaves it plain. `format: 'user'` shows a Nextcloud user id as the user's display name, read once per id; the entry stays empty until the name is known. `template` ("\{available\} \{unit\}") fills its `{path}` placeholders from the record instead of reading `path`; it is empty when every placeholder is. `suffix` (" kg") is added to a value that is not empty. - `action` — an action drawn as a button under the facts; `headerAction` — one drawn in the card header (reported through the `header` event). - `actions` — action buttons under the facts in the `headerActions` shape (`api-call`, `open-form`, `navigate`, `open-modal`, ...; `confirm`, `variant`). `@source.&lt;field&gt;` names a field of the record shown, and an action whose token names an empty field is not drawn. `visibleWhen` reads the record shown; `adminOnly: true` draws the action for an instance admin only (visibility, never authorisation). An api-call or a saved form refreshes the page, and the facts read their source again. - `rowsPath` — a path to a list of `{ label, value }` the record holds, drawn as rows after `fields` (a preview the server builds). - `headerPill` — a status pill in the card header (reported through the `header` event): `{ path?, text?, map?, variant?, variantMap?, colorMap? }`, read from the record like a `pill` entry (DqBezwaar "Advies ontvangen"); nothing shows while the value is empty. - `notice` — `{ text, variant? }`, a note band inside the card under the facts (`info` by default; `success`, `warning` or `error`); the text is translated. `format` is `text` (default), `date` (board short date), `date-long` (always with the year), `list` (an array joined by ", ", each item read at `itemPath`), `bytes` (a size, "1.5 MB"), `number` (in the reader's language, `decimals` fraction digits when set) or `currency` (a money amount in the reader's language, "€ 1.234,50": the code in `currency`, else the record's `currencyField`, else the app's reporting currency, else EUR; `decimals` defaults to 2). `map` turns a raw value into a label (translated). `parts` (on a `line`) lists paths, or `{ path, label?, format? }`, joined by `separator` (default " · "); empty parts are dropped. - `source` — `{ register, schema, id }` or `{ url }`; omitted = the current object. `{ register, schema, filter, sort? }` without `id` reads the first object that matches `filter` in `sort` order (`{ field, dir }`): the latest count of a shift. An entry with `from: "object"` reads the current object even then (a client card that also shows the ticket's channel). - `endpointSource` — `{ url, method?, params?, responsePath? }`, the block a stat or chart takes: the facts read an app endpoint, shared and cached like those. - `emptyWhen` — a path; when the record's value there is truthy the card shows `emptyText` (an endpoint that answers `empty: true`). - `link` — `{ label, route? \| href? }` at the foot. - `hideEmpty` — drop an entry whose value is empty (default true). - `columns` — `2` lays the rows out in two columns with the label above the value (board DqContact); a row with `parts` joins them like a line (an address on one row). - `emptyText` — shown when no entry has a value. |
